node_types.GOVERNANCE_THEME: One of the four Governance dimensions

node_attributes.name: Normalized entity name
node_attributes.article_frequency: Number of Governance-related articles containing the entity

CO_MENTIONED_WITH.weight: Number of Governance-related articles in which both entities occur

ASSOCIATED_WITH_THEME.weight: Number of articles in which the entity occurs together with the Governance theme

REGULATES.meaning: Subject regulates or restricts the object

INVESTIGATES.meaning: Subject investigates or audits the object

FINES.meaning: Subject imposes a fine or penalty on the object

SUES.meaning: Subject takes legal action against the object

COMPLIES_WITH.meaning: Subject complies with or aligns to the object

ADOPTS.meaning: Subject adopts, passes or implements the object

PROPOSES.meaning: Subject proposes or drafts the object

DEVELOPS.meaning: Subject develops or releases the object

extracted_edge_attributes.record_id: Source article in the AI Media Dataset
extracted_edge_attributes.date: Publication date of the source article
extracted_edge_attributes.evidence: Exact text span stating the relation

graph_files.ai_governance_knowledge_graph_enriched.g: Additionally Governance themes with ASSOCIATED_WITH_THEME edges
graph_files.ai_governance_relation_graph.graphml: Entities with LLM-extracted, directed and source-linked relations
